diagram_math_checks.objects_maps: D prime is the componentwise image of i; E prime is H(E,jk); u prime is the restriction of u and v prime is the induced cycle-quotient map (F1, step 1.1). All six vertical maps have bidegree zero. Nodes are explicitly indexed families, not infinite direct sums.
diagram_math_checks.domains_codomains: For the i prime square, left column is D prime at (p,q), right is D prime at (p+1,q-1), and target row is the tilded version. For j prime the right column is E prime at (p-r,q+r). For k prime the left is E prime at (p,q) and right D prime at (p-1,q). These are exactly def-derived-exact-couple Definition.
diagram_math_checks.relations: The three squares assert u prime i prime = tilde i prime u prime; v prime j prime = tilde j prime u prime; u prime k prime = tilde k prime v prime. Step 2.1 proves respectively the restriction identity on a, the local formula a=ix giving [vjx]=[tilde j ux], and the cycle formula u k e=tilde k v e. The local-lifting supplier authorizes epic cancellation and quotient descent; no chosen global lift is depicted. All horizontal arrows go right and vertical arrows down.
